related_questions.question: What does Globus travel insurance cover?

text_blocks.snippet: Globus travel insurance, offered through their SafetyNet and Travel Protection plans, provides coverage for trip cancellations, interruptions, delays, medical expenses, emergency evacuation, baggage loss or delay, and 24/7 assistance. Specific benefits can vary, so it's important to review the plan details carefully.
snippet_highlighted_words: trip cancellations, interruptions, delays, medical expenses, emergency evacuation, baggage loss or delay, and 24/7 assistance

list.title: Trip Cancellation:
list.snippet: Allows cancellation for covered reasons (like illness, injury, or visa issues) before departure with potential refunds or travel credits.

list.title: Trip Interruption:
list.snippet: Covers expenses if your trip is interrupted due to a covered event.

list.title: Trip Delay:
list.snippet: Provides coverage for expenses incurred due to delays, like accommodation or meals.

list.title: Medical Expenses:
list.snippet: Covers medical costs incurred during your trip, including emergency medical transportation.

list.title: Emergency Medical Evacuation:
list.snippet: Covers the cost of evacuating you to a medical facility or back home if necessary.

list.title: Baggage Loss/Delay:
list.snippet: Provides coverage for lost, stolen, or damaged baggage, as well as baggage delays.

list.title: 24/7 Assistance:
list.snippet: Offers support and guidance for various travel-related issues, including replacing lost medications.

list.title: Cancel for Any Reason:
list.snippet: Some policies allow cancellation for any reason up to a certain point before departure, with potential refunds or travel credits.

list.title: Transfer Protection:
list.snippet: Some plans allow you to transfer your trip to a later date with minimal penalties.

list.title: SafetyNet Protection:
list.snippet: Globus' SafetyNet provides flexibility to cancel or transfer your booking up to 30 days before departure, with specific conditions.

list.title: Coverage varies:
list.snippet: Always review the specific terms and conditions of your chosen plan to understand the exact coverage details.

list.title: Purchase time:
list.snippet: Travel protection plans are often most effective when purchased at the time of booking or shortly after.

list.title: Non-refundable:
list.snippet: Travel insurance premiums are generally non-refundable once purchased.

list.title: Airline issues:
list.snippet: For airfare purchased through Globus, they may be able to assist with airline schedule changes before check-in, but after check-in, you'll need to work with the airline directly.

related_questions.question: Which is better, Trafalgar or Globus?

text_blocks.snippet: Both Globus and Trafalgar are reputable escorted tour operators, but they cater to slightly different preferences and budgets. Globus is generally considered more upscale with a focus on higher-quality hotels and more included features, while Trafalgar offers a wider range of price points and travel styles, including some budget-friendly options.
snippet_highlighted_words: Globus is generally considered more upscale with a focus on higher-quality hotels and more included features, while Trafalgar offers a wider range of price points and travel styles, including some budget-friendly options

list.title: Upscale Experience:
list.snippet: Generally considered to offer a more premium experience with higher-quality hotels and more included features.

list.title: Larger Group Sizes:
list.snippet: While they offer smaller group options, Globus tours often have larger groups compared to Insight Vacations.

list.title: Established Reputation:
list.snippet: Globus has a long-standing reputation for quality and reliability.

list.title: Emphasis on Inclusions:
list.snippet: Globus tends to include more meals and sightseeing in their tours, minimizing extra costs during the trip.

list.title: Broader Range of Price Points:
list.snippet: Trafalgar offers a wider variety of tours, including some budget-friendly options, in addition to premium tours.

list.title: "Insider Experiences":
list.snippet: Trafalgar is known for its "Insider Experiences," which offer unique opportunities to connect with locals and experience destinations in a more authentic way.

list.title: Smaller Group Options:
list.snippet: Trafalgar also offers tours with smaller group sizes for a more intimate experience.

list.title: Sister Company:
list.snippet: Trafalgar and Costsaver are sister companies, with Costsaver being the more budget-friendly option.

text_blocks.snippet: The "better" choice depends on individual preferences and budget.

list.snippet: For a more premium experience with more included features: Globus might be a better fit.
For a wider range of price points and travel styles, including some budget options: Trafalgar could be a better choice.
If you value unique local experiences: Trafalgar's "Insider Experiences" might be appealing.
If you want to minimize extra costs during the trip: Globus's emphasis on inclusions could be beneficial.

text_blocks.snippet: Ultimately, it's recommended to compare specific itineraries and inclusions of tours that interest you from both companies to make the best decision for your trip.
